setting: small mountain-village middle school during the day; navy school uniforms; teacher-led classroom scenes

sentences.english: One day after school, our teacher asked us to gather in the classroom.
sentences.japanese: ある放課後、先生が教室にみんなを集めました。

sentences.english: In a quiet voice, she said, “I want all of you to read more books.”
sentences.japanese: 静かな声で、「みんな、もっと本を読んでほしいの」と言いました。

sentences.english: “My mother always tells me to finish my homework before I play,” my sister added.
sentences.japanese: 「うちの母はいつも、遊ぶ前に宿題を終わらせるように言うの」と妹が付け加えました。

sentences.english: “My father asks me to help with the housework on weekends,” my brother laughed.
sentences.japanese: 「父さんは週末、家事を手伝ってほしいって言うんだ」と兄は笑いました。

sentences.english: Tom gave me a small letter with a little shyness.
sentences.japanese: トムはちょっと照れながら、小さな手紙を渡してくれました。

sentences.english: “I want you to come to my birthday party,” the letter said.
sentences.japanese: 「誕生日パーティーに来てほしい」と書いてありました。

sentences.english: I also want my grandmother to live happily for a long time.
sentences.japanese: わたしは、おばあちゃんにも長く元気でいてほしいと思っています。

sentences.english: Our teacher told us to think deeply about the questions in class.
sentences.japanese: 先生は授業の問いについて、深く考えてほしいと言いました。

sentences.english: “I want you to discover how fun learning can be,” she said.
sentences.japanese: 「学ぶことがどれだけ楽しいか、発見してほしいのよ」と。
